trigger_condition.memory_trigger: The output tensor passed via the out parameter is non-contiguous.
trigger_condition.execution_trigger: Using an out= variant of softmax, such as torch._softmax(..., out=out).
trigger_condition.concrete_constraints: Input tensor can be contiguous; output tensor has the same shape/dtype/device as the input but a non-contiguous memory layout; softmax is computed along a specified dimension.

root_cause.description: The aten::_softmax.out implementation does not correctly handle non-contiguous output tensors, causing partial writes to incorrect memory locations.

bug_oracle.description: The output tensor contains invalid softmax values; some positions are not updated correctly and negative values may appear.
bug_oracle.signal: Mismatch between torch._softmax(input, dim, half_to_float=False, out=out) and the reference torch._softmax(input, dim, half_to_float=False); non-contiguous out contains incorrect or negative values.

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Generate output tensors with diverse non-contiguous memory layouts using transpose, slice, permute, narrow, or as_strided; verify with is_contiguous().
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Create input and output tensors of the same shape, dtype, and device; construct out tensors as non-contiguous variants, and include contiguous baselines for comparison.
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Force softmax operations to use the out= parameter with a non-contiguous output buffer; vary the softmax dimension and input shape.
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: Call torch._softmax(input, dim, half_to_float=False, out=out) and compare with torch._softmax(input.contiguous(), dim, half_to_float=False) and torch._softmax(input, dim, half_to_float=False).
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: Compare out= results against reference softmax outputs using allclose; treat any mismatch, negative softmax value, or unchanged output position as a failure.
